core_obligations: Justify the identification making the transported derivation well defined, using that differentials are compatible with etale localisation.
Reduce to affine opens and verify the commutativity of the square on the level of ring maps with the derivations written out.

proof_roadmap.step: Establish the identification that defines the transported derivation.
Reduce the commutativity to the affine case.
Check the commutativity on ring maps with the derivations made explicit.

difficulty_reason: Given a square of first order thickenings with etale horizontal morphisms on the underlying schemes and target bases, the lemma shows that the two canonical actions by derivations commute with the square, where the derivation acting on the lower thickening transports to the upper one along the etale morphisms. The proof first justifies the equality sign in the definition of the transported derivation using the identification of sheaves of differentials for etale localisation, then reduces the commutativity to affine opens and checks it on the level of ring maps with the derivations written out explicitly. The construction and verification of the transported derivation is the substance. Retained author proof at lines 2079-2137.
